name: tianshu-imbridge
description: Tianshu IM bridge plugin — mobile QQ / WeChat messages flow directly into Tianshu and replies go straight back (no DSH relay in between).

tianshu.name: tianshu-imbridge
tianshu.description: Mobile IM <-> Tianshu direct bridge: plugin residency + QQ & WeChat channels + agent-driven WeChat binding + headless call + reply routing

tools.name: im_status
tools.description: Report the IM bridge status: phase, process info, per-channel connection state, WeChat binding progress

tools.name: im_send
tools.description: Send a proactive message to the owner over QQ or WeChat (notification)

tools.name: weixin_bind_start
tools.description: Start WeChat (iLink/ClawBot) binding: puts a QR code image on the user's Desktop and waits for the scan in the background

tools.name: weixin_bind_status
tools.description: Check the WeChat binding progress and get the next step the user must do
